# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger hash seed generation**

## Highlights

Unreleased changes use operating-system cryptographic randomness to seed hash codes in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Cryptographically generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode polyfill now uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random in both assemblies. Hash codes remain stable within a process; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
